text:
Maya Kapoor: quick capture from Nimbus onboarding call — posting raw asks for product triage.
Ethan Brooks: thanks Maya. can you bullet top pain points?
Maya Kapoor: 1) Need per-route throttling controls for heavy inference routes. 2) Missing audit logs for call-level metadata (who/why). 3) Cold-start latency concern on dedicated pools during batch jobs. 4) Embedding dedupe option to avoid redundant compute.
Samira Ali: adding customer quotes: 'our analytics jobs doubled our token bill unexpectedly' and 'we can't tell which team triggered the big runs'.
Theo Gardner: sounds like two tracks: billing/visibility + runtime controls. throttling is product + infra; audit logs are security/compliance.
Ethan Brooks: priority suggestion: audit logs = P1 (security ask), throttling controls = P1 (prevents runaway cost), dedupe = P2 (optimizes cost), cold-start improvements = P2 (perf).
Maya Kapoor: repro notes: they ran a scheduled batch that hit a single route with 40 concurrent jobs, some calls returned 429s. sample curl snippet from their logs:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"..."}'
# response: {"status":429,"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":12}
```
Samira Ali: they asked for a UI knob to cap per-route qps with a soft/ hard limit and email alerts when crossed.
Theo Gardner: engineering note: per-route qps gating needs routing-layer change + console surface. rough estimate: gating prototype 2 weeks, console + alerts 1 sprint. audit logs: 1 sprint to stream call metadata to S3 + search index.
Ethan Brooks: customer is in upsell window; these are renewal-influencing. recommend we push audit logs and throttling into a fast-follow roadmap slot.
Maya Kapoor: action items: (1) Ethan to open product ticket with priority and expected business impact, link this thread. (2) Theo to scope infra changes and share a spec. (3) CS to offer workaround: enable global rate caps per project + manual monitoring until per-route shipped.
ops-bot: Reminder set - follow up with Nimbus in 5 business days.
Maya Kapoor: I'll post the onboarding recording and their example job JSON in the shared folder.
Samira Ali: noted, will draft the customer-facing workaround email.
Theo Gardner: starting a draft spec, will attach to the ticket.
Ethan Brooks: thanks all. keeping renewal on radar. :eyes:
Maya Kapoor: end of thread.
